2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to compute and pay to the petitioners for acquisition of their lands 5 acres 58 cents in S.No.242 situated at Karanai Revenue Village, Cheyyar Taluk, Tiruvannamalai District, under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purpose Act, 1997, covered under Award Notice of the 4th Respondent in Na.Ka.No.A2/324/2021 dated 03.02.2025, the benefits under the provisions of sections 26 to 30 and also Chapter V & I, II Schedule of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and also to dispose of the common representation of the petitioners dated 20.06.2023, 01.07.2024 and 03.03.2025.
